name: Liwyrm
dexEntry: Many mistake Liwyrm for tiny dragons, which lead to its nickname 'Dragonhead'. Their green skin helps them camouflage amongst the leafage of trees, but if they do get spotted by a Flying-type Pokémon, Liwyrm will rear up and flail with all four of its tiny arms. Surprisingly this strategy scares off a majority of its predators. If this wasn't enough, Liwyrm will resort to stinging the enemy with the poisonous tips on their tail and escape as far as its tiny legs can carry it.
